post_back.text:
What came up about OpenRouter in public this week.
Two Reddit threads report keys stolen and balances drained. If you have ever pasted a key into a third-party app, check your activity log, set a credit limit on the key, and rotate it if anything looks off.
The questions we saw most: the cheapest way to top up, how zero data retention compares with going direct, and how to send a model to its cheapest provider. DeepSeek's share of traffic was the week's talking point, and a lot of you shared what you built: frontends, CLI tools, plugins.
One question back: when you give your key to an app, what would make you trust it?
post_back.why: The model's draft repeated the unconfirmed cause by name and the third-party figure as fact. Rewritten by hand, with the same content otherwise.
